method: Fresh Chrome contexts test real map controls, preference persistence across products/languages/reload, global revocation, invalid/expired state, blocked storage, cross-tab synchronization, no-JavaScript fallback, keyboard and responsive accessibility. Normal tests intercept and abort every external request, including Google iframe navigation; expected blocked-resource console messages are recorded separately from application errors.
limits: Aborted Google requests prove connection intent, not rendered geographical accuracy, tiles, attribution or third-party cookie behavior. Optional live-provider checks are separate and require CHECK_LIVE_GOOGLE_MAPS=1. Chrome emulation is not physical iOS/Safari certification. Browser storage is functional map preference, not an advertising CMP.
